verses.text: How terrible it will be for those who lie awake planning evil, making wicked plans in their beds! As soon as morning comes, they carry them out, because they have the power to do it.
They want fields, so they take them. They want houses, so they grab them. They cheat people out of their homes and steal their inheritance.

So this is what the LORD says: "I am planning disaster against these people, and you will not be able to save your necks from it. You will no longer walk proudly, because it will be a time of disaster.

On that day people will make fun of you. They will mock you with this sad song: 'We are completely ruined! The LORD has divided up my people's land. He has taken it away from me and given our fields to traitors.'"
So you will have no one in the LORD's assembly to divide the land by lot.
"Do not prophesy," their prophets say. "Do not prophesy about these things. Disgrace will not come on us."
Should it be said, people of Jacob, "Is the Spirit of the LORD impatient? Does he do such things?" "Do not my words do good to the one who lives honestly?
But lately my people have turned against me like an enemy. You strip the fine robes off people who pass by without a care, like men coming home from war.
You drive the women of my people out of their pleasant homes. You take away my blessing from their children forever.
Get up and go away! This is no longer a place where you can rest, because it is unclean. It is ruined beyond all repair.
If a liar and a cheat comes and says, 'I will preach to you about wine and beer,' that would be just the prophet for these people!

"I will surely gather all of you, Jacob. I will surely bring together the survivors of Israel. I will bring them together like sheep in a pen, like a flock in its pasture. The place will be full of people.
The one who breaks open the way will go up ahead of them. They will break through the gate and go out. Their king will go before them, the LORD at their head."
